title: Only one craft has ever visited Neptune
description:
Voyager 2 flew past Neptune in 1989. This scene is built from its flyby images, and the stars come from a sky survey in Camelopardalis.
NASA picture of the day, 21 Nov 2026. Assembly/Processing - Rolf Olsen, Data - Voyager 2, NASA Planetary Data System.
Every day’s picture: https://cosmos.rimilab.com/
